name: Claude Code v2.1.207 — Auto Mode Default on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry; Linux Desktop Beta; Plugin Shell Injection Fix; 22 Changes
hook: v2.1.207 (July 11) ships 22 changes. Headline: auto mode is now on by default for Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry — no CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE env var needed; disable via disableAutoMode in settings. Both Bedrock and Vertex default to Claude Opus 4.8. Security: plugin shell-form commands that reference ${user_config.*} are now rejected (shell-injection fix) — update hooks to exec form or $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_<KEY>. Also: Claude Desktop for Linux is now shipping in beta for Ubuntu 22.04+ and Debian 12+ (x86_64 and arm64) — full Chat, Cowork, and Claude Code experience; install via the Anthropic apt repo. Claude in Chrome extension is out of preview for direct Anthropic plan users — Claude Code can now open tabs, click pages, fill forms, and share your browser login state to test apps it builds.

name: SkillCloak — HKUST Researchers Show Malicious Claude Code Skills Can Evade Static Scanners at 90%+ Rate
hook: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology researchers published 'Cloak and Detonate: Scanner Evasion and Dynamic Detection of Agent Skill Malware' (July 6) introducing SkillCloak — a self-extracting packing technique that rewrites suspicious tokens, credential paths, and URLs into semantically equivalent forms the agent quietly reassembles at runtime, evading static skill scanners at 90%+ rates. Demonstrated payloads steal credentials, exfiltrate source code, and install backdoors while appearing benign to the same scanners tools like AgentShield and ECC run. Runtime behavior auditing is far more resilient than static analysis. Covered by The Hacker News, Help Net Security, and GB Hackers. Key takeaway: don't install skills from untrusted sources even if they pass a scanner.

name: Graphify — ~82K Stars; v0.9.12 July 10; Day 7 of Daily Release Cadence; 71.5x Token Savings
hook: Graphify's daily release cadence continues with v0.9.12 shipping July 10. This week's additions — PostgreSQL live schema introspection (graph refreshes automatically on schema changes) and Streamable HTTP MCP transport for remote deployments — round out what started as a 'parse once, query always' codebase tool into a living database-aware agent memory system. ~82K stars. YC S26.

name: bradautomates/claude-video — ~8K Stars; /watch Lets Claude Watch Any Video; Up ~1K Stars/Day
hook: A Claude Code plugin that gives Claude the ability to watch and reason over video. Paste a YouTube, TikTok, Vimeo, or local file URL into /watch — it downloads, extracts scene-aware keyframes, deduplicates near-identical frames, transcribes audio (captions or Whisper), and feeds the full picture to Claude in-session. v0.2.0 launched July 1 and has grown roughly 1,000 stars per day since, reaching ~8K stars today. Practical use cases: analyzing tutorial videos, debugging against screencasts, understanding design references in motion.

name: Claude Code Steganography — Day 12; Anthropic Post-Mortem Still Absent; 12 Days Without a Statement
hook: Twelve days since June 30's discovery that Claude Code v2.1.91–v2.1.196 (April 2 through June 30) silently embedded timezone and proxy-hostname signals in hidden Unicode — and Anthropic has still not published a formal post-mortem. The story's major consequences are now behind us: v2.1.197+ is clean, Alibaba's company-wide Claude Code ban took effect July 10, and employees have been redirected to Qoder. What remains open is whether Anthropic will explain the decision to embed the tracking mechanism rather than the decision to remove it.
recurring_note: ↑ Day 12 — no post-mortem after 12 days; v2.1.197+ is clean; Alibaba ban effective

name: thedotmack/claude-mem — 86.7K Stars; Persistent Memory via 5 Lifecycle Hooks + ChromaDB; Day 3
hook: claude-mem hooks into Claude Code's five session lifecycle events (SessionStart through SessionEnd) to capture what the agent does, AI-compress it, store it in SQLite + ChromaDB locally, and inject semantically relevant context back into every future session — no manual CLAUDE.md management. Free, Apache 2.0, v13.10.2. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, and OpenCode. 86.7K stars after entering awesome-claude-code as an 'instant persistent memory system' this week.
